turns.reply:
The fix is in `rich/traceback.py`: `Traceback.extract` now tracks the ids of exceptions it has already visited, and stops following `__cause__` or `__context__` when it would revisit one. This prevents the unbounded loop on cyclic exception chains.

I checked it with a self-referencing `__context__` (rendered once, no hang) and `tests/test_traceback.py` passes (21 passed, 1 skipped). I did not add a regression test, and I did not confirm against the exact scenarios in issues #3682 and #3708.
